'''Quilsen''' was a [[Spiner]] who had become down-and-out and used the [[phetaril]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]]<ref name="SWI 67" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Following that event, the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] met Quilsen while she was touring a string of seedy [[Cantina/Legends|bars]] along the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Quilsen introduced Snootles to phetaril, and from that point onward the Pa'lowick would drown her sorrows in the spice.<ref name="SWI 67" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quilsen was mentioned in "[[Who's Who in the Max Rebo Band]]," an article [[Rich Handley]] wrote for the [[Star Wars Insider 67|sixty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="SWI 67" /> that was released on [[April 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/03/news20030317.html|text=Celebrate <i>Jedi</i>'s 20th in ''Insider'' #67}}</ref>
